cohort: The study included 156 women with type 1 diabetes mellitus and a singleton gestation who delivered between 2006 and 2014 at a tertiary hospital and received care at a dedicated DM clinic.
finding: Women with type 1 DM treated with multiple daily injections (MDI) were significantly more likely to have glycemic control admissions and postprandial hypoglycemia during pregnancy compared to those treated with continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII).
